Identifying an issue and citing external work speaks to specificity, not grounding; grounding requires the referenced part of the paper to be identifiable, which this comment does not provide. Thus, while the comment is specific about what is missing, it falls short of being fully grounded because it does not pinpoint the part of the paper it addresses.
